newsitem.title: USA: Boston Edison to redeem 8.25 pct preferred.
newsitem.headline: Boston Edison to redeem 8.25 pct preferred.

text.p: Boston Edison Co said Wednesday it will redeem on June 1 all of the outstanding shares of its depositary preferred shares, 8.25 percent series.
Each of the depositary shares represent a one-fourth interest in a share of the company's cumulative preferred stock, 8.25 prefered series.
The redemption price is $25 for each depositary share, plus accrued dividends of $0.171875 for the period May 1 to June 1, it said.
The last regular dividend payable, which is $0.515625 per depositary share for the period February 1 through April 30, will be paid on May 1 to the holders of record as of April 10, it said.
By June 1 the dividends on the stock will cease to accrue, it said.
